releases.changelog:
Final v27 combines the features and corrections developed through Beta 3, Beta 4 and Beta 5.

- Ghost Mode: independent conversation/Story/view-once controls, Seen after reply, Seen after reacting and an optional in-chat Mark as seen button. Eligible incoming view-once media is preserved when Keep View-Once Media is on, and uses native consumption bookkeeping when it is off.
- Keep Unsent Messages: optional local preservation, inline copies, account-isolated searchable archive and confirmed cleanup.
- Stories: organizer filters, background native loading, exact counters when data is complete, separate manual/interaction receipts and header-aligned mention indicators. Supported Friends/Reels trays use filters, Hide tray highlights and local dark colors. The full Stories summary retains native behavior with colors only.
- Download Center: First frame, Audio only, Story Photo only, carousel choices, supported voice downloads and optional photo/GIF comment downloads.
- Fonts & emojis: separate app/chat fonts, local emoji packs and reaction rendering, creative Direct drafts and Story fonts. Native audio upload includes preview and explicit send confirmation.
- Instants: six independent opt-in controls for UI, zoom, swiping, downloads, gallery upload and screenshots.
- Like protection: optional separate post/Reel delay, 3/5/10 seconds (default 5), with Undo and cancellation before dispatch. Existing double-tap controls remain independent.
- Themes and layout: scoped discovery/search/request/News/Reels/Direct colors; dynamic likes-list palette, AMOLED and recycled rows; native Follow/avatar actions preserved; reduced repeated Home theme work.
- Settings: all ten main cards show title, centered scene artwork and description. About has one Developers section, official/community links and MOD settings Export/Import with optional current-account developer flags. Accounts, archives, files and Android folder permissions are excluded.
- Updates: official API, variant/ABI selection and opt-in foreground checks, with notification and Home Download/Close announcement.

The final certificate differs from Beta 5. Export desired settings before removing the earlier same-package install, then install the matching final APK. The embedded editorial build number is unknown (-1); OTA uses version/channel comparison. Fresh final-APK visual and live server behavior acceptance remains pending.
